notes: Dev ABox revision carried by the inverse property: on_river is the inverse of flows_through, so the related-near question asks the removed fact from the river's side ("Does the Danube flow through Budapest?": yes, then no). on_river is many-valued in general, so the edit says "the only river": that makes the replace explicit (the Rhine takes the Danube's place rather than joining it), so the related-near "no" follows from the edit plus the inverse, and "the river that Budapest lies on" in the related-far and derived questions picks out one river. The new value is another well-known river, so the edit reaches stored and worked-out facts through the river: related far reaches Budapest by its role (the capital of Hungary, binding), and the three derived questions follow the edit to the Rhine and look up a stored fact about it (composition: its source country, the sea it flows into, and whether it passes Cologne). on_river has no transitive, chain or subproperty tag, so these task routes use derivation none. The Danube's stored course is not a world-splitting background belief here: the questions ask about "the river that Budapest lies on", which names the edited relation, not the Danube. Near unrelated asks the river of another Danube capital: an edit that swaps the Danube for the Rhine everywhere would answer the Rhine there. Counts are exact-phrase counts in Dolma (v4_dolma-v1_7_llama) except those marked approximate.
